feeds.title: Six Physio Blog
feeds.description: Six Physio are leading independent physiotherapists & sports injury specialists, offering expert treatment in a range of services including Physiotherapy, Lower Back Pain, Sports Massage, Six Pilates, Sports Physiotherapy, Biomechanical Sports Assessments and Work Station Ergonomics.

feeds.title: RunningPhysio
feeds.description: The site offers advice to runners on injury treatment and prevention. Written by Tom Goom, a physiotherapist with over 15 years of experience and a very keen runner.

feeds.title: Complete Physio
feeds.description: Complete Physio is a group of private physiotherapy clinics located across London, providing first class physiotherapy and sports injury treatment. Our team uses the most up-to-date and evidence-based treatments to get you out of pain and back to full function.

feeds.title: Go Physio Blog
feeds.description: From our years of experience in resolving thousands of people's injuries, we have develped The goPhysio Way. The goPhysio Way is our unique approach to helping you get back to doing what you enjoy and performing at your physical best. We look to not only remedy your immediate issues but also deliver long-term, physical durability. We go beyond just recovering your injury, by helping you improve your physical well being and preventing future injuries or reoccurrences.

feeds.title: physiotalk
feeds.description: Physiotalk is a tweetchat community for physiotherapists by physiotherapists. It is run by volunteers, and everything we do is free and open access. Learn, share, influence: helping physiotherapists to make the most of social media to discuss best practice, develop practice & improve services.

feeds.title: Physio Comes To You Blog
feeds.description: Physiocomestoyou Ltd was formed in 2007 by Rebecca Aldridge (nee Garrod) having realised the lack of physiotherapists specialising in treating people at home and work throughout London. Physio Comes To You offer a range of London Physio Therapy treatments from qualified practitioners either at home, your work or our private clinic

feeds.title: Kensington Physio & Sports Medicine
feeds.description: We are a group of practices in Central and West London, including Chelsea, Kensington, Notting Hill and Wandsworth. We have a long, proud history of treating and rehabilitating local patients and Olympic athletes. Welcome to the Kensington Physio blog. Here you will find the latest company news, information on injury and recovery, and other advice. Take a look today!

feeds.title: Front Foot Physiotherapy Blog
feeds.description: View daily articles on physiotherapy, sports massage, and general health. The Front Foot Physiotherapy Blog is packed with insights on Taping methods, Injuries, and more. Front Foot Physiotherapy is a clinic in Surrey operated by Katherine Emms MSc MCSP, a qualified, chartered physiotherapist and a keen sportsperson.

feeds.title: The Chartered Society of Physiotherapy
feeds.description: The CSP is the professional, educational and trade union body for the UK's 53,000 chartered physiotherapists, students and support workers. Our mission is to raise the profile of the profession and awareness of the benefits physiotherapy offers in preventing ill health, increasing independence for people with long term conditions, and rehabilitation after illness and accident.
